1 /**
2  * A1 discovery — CLI/env roots, no registry.
3  * First match wins: strip.json or ECGBERHT.md Strip fence.
4  * Scan listed roots + one level of subdirs; ignore junk; empty → structured empty.
5  */
6 
7 import fs from 'node:fs';
8 import path from 'node:path';
9 import {
10   FACE_FILE_NAME,
11   STRIP_FILE_NAME,
12   extractStripFence,
13   hasStripFenceMarker,
14   parseStrip,
15   toStripProjection,
16 } from './face-strip.mjs';
17 
18 /** Env var: OS path separator (path.delimiter) separated list of roots. */
19 export const ENV_STRIP_ROOTS = 'ECGBERHT_STRIP_ROOTS';
20 
21 /** Directory basenames skipped during scan (junk). */
22 export const JUNK_DIR_NAMES = Object.freeze([
23   'node_modules',
24   '.git',
25   'vendor',
26   '.hg',
27   '.svn',
28   '.trash',
29   'dist',
30   'build',
31   'coverage',
32   '__pycache__',
33   '.cache',
34   'tmp',
35   'temp',
36 ]);
37 
38 const JUNK_SET = new Set(JUNK_DIR_NAMES.map((n) => n.toLowerCase()));
39 
40 /**
41  * Parse ECGBERHT_STRIP_ROOTS (or any delimiter-separated string).
42  * @param {string|undefined|null} envValue
43  * @param {string} [delimiter] defaults to path.delimiter
44  * @returns {string[]}
45  */
46 export function parseRootsFromEnv(envValue, delimiter = path.delimiter) {
47   if (envValue == null || envValue === '') return [];
48   if (typeof envValue !== 'string') return [];
49   return envValue
50     .split(delimiter)
51     .map((s) => s.trim())
52     .filter(Boolean);
53 }
54 
55 /**
56  * Parse CLI argv for --roots and --project.
57  * Forms: --roots a;b  OR  --roots a --roots b  OR  --roots=a;b
58  * On Windows path.delimiter is `;`; also accept `,` as soft separator inside one token.
59  * @param {string[]} argv
60  * @returns {{ roots: string[], project: string|null, rest: string[] }}
61  */
62 export function parseRootsFromCliArgs(argv = []) {
63   const roots = [];
64   let project = null;
65   const rest = [];
66   const tokens = Array.isArray(argv) ? [...argv] : [];
67 
68   for (let i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
69     const t = tokens[i];
70     if (t === '--roots' || t === '-R') {
71       const next = tokens[i + 1];
72       if (next && !next.startsWith('-')) {
73         roots.push(...splitRootToken(next));
74         i++;
75       }
76       continue;
77     }
78     if (t.startsWith('--roots=')) {
79       roots.push(...splitRootToken(t.slice('--roots='.length)));
80       continue;
81     }
82     if (t === '--project' || t === '-p') {
83       const next = tokens[i + 1];
84       if (next && !next.startsWith('-')) {
85         project = next;
86         i++;
87       }
88       continue;
89     }
90     if (t.startsWith('--project=')) {
91       project = t.slice('--project='.length);
92       continue;
93     }
94     rest.push(t);
95   }
96 
97   return { roots, project, rest };
98 }
99 
100 /**
101  * @param {string} token
102  */
103 function splitRootToken(token) {
104   // Prefer OS delimiter; also split on comma for ergonomics when not Windows-drive-ambiguous
105   const delim = path.delimiter;
106   let parts = token.split(delim).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
107   if (parts.length === 1 && delim !== ',' && token.includes(',')) {
108     // Only split commas when not looking like a single path with no delimiter use
109     parts = token.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
110   }
111   return parts;
112 }
113 
114 /**
115  * Resolve discovery roots: CLI --roots first, else env, else empty.
116  * A1 live path: when opts.env is omitted, read process.env.ECGBERHT_STRIP_ROOTS
117  * (no registry). opts.env / opts.envValue override for tests and injectors.
118  * @param {{ roots?: string[], env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv|object, envValue?: string|null }} [opts]
119  * @returns {string[]}
120  */
121 export function resolveDiscoveryRoots(opts = {}) {
122   const fromCli = Array.isArray(opts.roots) ? opts.roots.filter(Boolean) : [];
123   if (fromCli.length) return fromCli.map((r) => path.resolve(r));
124 
125   let envValue = opts.envValue;
126   if (envValue === undefined) {
127     // Live A1: process.env is the default host surface when env bag not injected
128     const env = opts.env !== undefined ? opts.env : process.env;
129     envValue = env?.[ENV_STRIP_ROOTS];
130   }
131   return parseRootsFromEnv(envValue).map((r) => path.resolve(r));
132 }
133 
134 /**
135  * @param {string} name basename
136  */
137 export function isJunkDirName(name) {
138   if (!name || typeof name !== 'string') return true;
139   if (name === '.' || name === '..') return true;
140   return JUNK_SET.has(name.toLowerCase());
141 }
142 
143 /**
144  * Does this directory contain strip.json?
145  * @param {string} dir
146  */
147 export function findStripJson(dir) {
148   const p = path.join(dir, STRIP_FILE_NAME);
149   try {
150     if (fs.existsSync(p) && fs.statSync(p).isFile()) return p;
151   } catch {
152     return null;
153   }
154   return null;
155 }
156 
157 /**
158  * Does this directory contain ECGBERHT.md with a Strip fence?
159  * Reads Face only to extract fence JSON — not a full narrative rank path.
160  * @param {string} dir
161  * @returns {{ path: string|null, strip: object|null, has_fence: boolean }}
162  */
163 export function findStripFenceInFace(dir) {
164   const p = path.join(dir, FACE_FILE_NAME);
165   try {
166     if (!fs.existsSync(p) || !fs.statSync(p).isFile()) {
167       return { path: null, strip: null, has_fence: false };
168     }
169     const raw = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8');
170     if (!hasStripFenceMarker(raw)) {
171       return { path: p, strip: null, has_fence: false };
172     }
173     const fence = extractStripFence(raw);
174     if (!fence.found) {
175       return { path: p, strip: null, has_fence: false };
176     }
177     const parsed = parseStrip(fence.strip);
178     return {
179       path: p,
180       strip: parsed.ok ? parsed.strip : fence.strip,
181       has_fence: true,
182     };
183   } catch {
184     return { path: null, strip: null, has_fence: false };
185   }
186 }
187 
188 /**
189  * First match wins for a single directory: strip.json, else Face fence.
190  * @param {string} dir
191  * @returns {object|null} discovery hit or null
192  */
193 export function discoverInDirectory(dir) {
194   const resolved = path.resolve(dir);
195   let stat;
196   try {
197     stat = fs.statSync(resolved);
198   } catch {
199     return null;
200   }
201   if (!stat.isDirectory()) return null;
202 
203   const base = path.basename(resolved);
204   if (isJunkDirName(base)) return null;
205 
206   const stripJson = findStripJson(resolved);
207   if (stripJson) {
208     try {
209       const raw = fs.readFileSync(stripJson, 'utf8');
210       const parsed = parseStrip(raw);
211       if (parsed.ok) {
212         return {
213           project_path: resolved,
214           strip_path: stripJson,
215           face_path: fs.existsSync(path.join(resolved, FACE_FILE_NAME))
216             ? path.join(resolved, FACE_FILE_NAME)
217             : null,
218           strip_source: 'strip.json',
219           strip: parsed.strip,
220           face_fully_loaded: false,
221           projection: toStripProjection(parsed.strip, {
222             project_path: resolved,
223             strip_source: 'strip.json',
224           }),
225         };
226       }
227     } catch {
228       // fall through to fence
229     }
230   }
231 
232   const fence = findStripFenceInFace(resolved);
233   if (fence.has_fence && fence.strip) {
234     return {
235       project_path: resolved,
236       strip_path: null,
237       face_path: fence.path,
238       strip_source: 'face_fence',
239       strip: fence.strip,
240       // Fence parse reads the Face file for the JSON block only — not rank-time full Face narrative use
241       face_fully_loaded: false,
242       projection: toStripProjection(fence.strip, {
243         project_path: resolved,
244         strip_source: 'face_fence',
245       }),
246     };
247   }
248 
249   return null;
250 }

252 /**
253  * A1 discovery under locked MVP scan depth: each listed root + one level of subdirs.
254  * Junk dirs skipped. Empty roots → structured empty (ok:true, strips:[]).
255  * No registry. First match wins per directory (strip.json over fence).
256  *
257  * Anti-N-full-read metric: face_full_reads stays 0 on this path (fence parse is
258  * projection-only; full Face narrative load is reserved for top-k drill-in / heal).
259  *
260  * @param {{ roots?: string[], env?: object, envValue?: string|null }} [opts]
261  * @returns {{ ok: true, strips: object[], roots: string[], empty: boolean, scanned: string[], skipped_junk: string[], face_full_reads: number, fence_partial_reads: number }}
262  */
263 export function discoverStrips(opts = {}) {
264   const roots = resolveDiscoveryRoots(opts);
265   const strips = [];
266   const scanned = [];
267   const skipped_junk = [];
268   const seen = new Set();
269   // Honest anti-N-full-read counters: discovery never full-loads Face narrative
270   let face_full_reads = 0;
271   let fence_partial_reads = 0;
272   let strip_json_reads = 0;
273 
274   if (roots.length === 0) {
275     return {
276       ok: true,
277       empty: true,
278       strips: [],
279       roots: [],
280       scanned: [],
281       skipped_junk: [],
282       face_full_reads: 0,
283       fence_partial_reads: 0,
284       strip_json_reads: 0,
285       message: 'No discovery roots (CLI --roots / ECGBERHT_STRIP_ROOTS empty)',
286       registry: false,
287     };
288   }
289 
290   for (const root of roots) {
291     collectHit(root, strips, scanned, seen, {
292       onFence: () => {
293         fence_partial_reads += 1;
294       },
295       onStripJson: () => {
296         strip_json_reads += 1;
297       },
298     });
299 
300     let entries = [];
301     try {
302       entries = fs.readdirSync(root, { withFileTypes: true });
303     } catch {
304       continue;
305     }
306 
307     for (const ent of entries) {
308       if (!ent.isDirectory()) continue;
309       if (isJunkDirName(ent.name)) {
310         skipped_junk.push(path.join(root, ent.name));
311         continue;
312       }
313       const child = path.join(root, ent.name);
314       collectHit(child, strips, scanned, seen, {
315         onFence: () => {
316           fence_partial_reads += 1;
317         },
318         onStripJson: () => {
319           strip_json_reads += 1;
320         },
321       });
322     }
323   }
324 
325   // face_full_reads intentionally remains 0: discover never calls full Face narrative load
326   return {
327     ok: true,
328     empty: strips.length === 0,
329     strips,
330     roots,
331     scanned,
332     skipped_junk,
333     face_full_reads,
334     fence_partial_reads,
335     strip_json_reads,
336     registry: false,
337     scan_depth: 1,
338     message:
339       strips.length === 0
340         ? 'Structured empty: no strip.json or Face Strip fence under roots'
341         : `Discovered ${strips.length} strip projection(s)`,
342   };
343 }
344 
345 /**
346  * @param {string} dir
347  * @param {object[]} strips
348  * @param {string[]} scanned
349  * @param {Set<string>} seen
350  * @param {{ onFence?: () => void, onStripJson?: () => void }} [hooks]
351  */
352 function collectHit(dir, strips, scanned, seen, hooks = {}) {
353   const key = path.resolve(dir);
354   if (seen.has(key)) return;
355   scanned.push(key);
356   const hit = discoverInDirectory(dir);
357   if (hit) {
358     seen.add(key);
359     if (hit.strip_source === 'face_fence' && typeof hooks.onFence === 'function') {
360       hooks.onFence();
361     }
362     if (hit.strip_source === 'strip.json' && typeof hooks.onStripJson === 'function') {
363       hooks.onStripJson();
364     }
365     strips.push(hit);
366   }
367 }
